title: Enhancing UAV Autonomous Navigation in Indoor Environments Using Reinforcement Learning and Convolutional Neural Networks
authors: H. Safarpour Motealegh Mahalegi; A. Farhadi; G. Molnár; E. Nagy
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
